# Novel Phoenix — full project context

Novel Phoenix is a static, public reading-progress site owned by Aden Ramirez. It presents one person's library exported from NovelFire or NovelPhoenix.com. It does not host novels, authenticate visitors, accept payments, run analytics, or expose a writable public API.

The published dataset includes novel titles, author names when available, chapter counts, progress percentages, third-party novel and chapter URLs, and snapshot timestamps. The current legacy snapshot contains 110 novels and 38,118 chapters read. It does not reliably identify the most recent reading event; the interface states this rather than inventing an order.

Visitors may search and sort the public library, inspect history generated by future snapshots, open source novel and chapter links, and customize independent light and dark color palettes. A CSV imported in the browser is processed locally and stored only as a local draft unless the owner explicitly downloads and publishes sanitized JSON.

Forward reading-progress events (a novel's chapter count increasing between two published snapshots) are also published as an Atom feed, generated at build time from the same public snapshot, so a feed reader can follow updates without polling the HTML page.

Canonical site: https://novel-phoenix-readlist.vercel.app/
